cause: Aqueous coating or drying heat discharges the moisture-labile alpha-CD complex
consequence: Product ships with little or no payload; all downstream data invalid
detection_method: Assay retained 1-MCP in finished insert vs mass added; mass balance
mitigation: Non-aqueous or low-water binder (shellac/ethanolic); ambient-to-mild drying; measure retention at every process change
kill_criterion: Retention below 50 percent of charged 1-MCP after coating and drying, with no low-water route achieving better

failure_mode: Premature release during storage before use
cause: Hygroscopic binder or inadequate overwrap admits moisture
consequence: No efficacy at point of use; unsellable
detection_method: Timed storage study with periodic headspace assay vs unwrapped control
mitigation: Barrier overwrap as a product component; low-hygroscopicity binder; desiccant if needed
kill_criterion: Payload loss materially degrades efficacy within a realistic warehouse window even in the intended overwrap

failure_mode: Release too fast (dumping) at package RH
cause: Binder too permeable; coat weight too low; local condensation
consequence: Headspace spikes then falls; no protection through the storage period
detection_method: Headspace GC time-course at the RH matrix
mitigation: Increase coat weight; lower-permeability binder; moisture-control topcoat (Architecture B)
kill_criterion: No binder/coat-weight combination extends release beyond a fraction of the required window

cause: Binder too impermeable; complex over-encapsulated
consequence: Effective headspace concentration never reached
detection_method: Headspace GC; residual assay of spent insert
mitigation: Reduce coat weight; more permeable binder; increase loading
kill_criterion: Effective concentration unreachable at any practical loading

cause: Release varies smoothly with RH instead of switching
consequence: The core differentiator fails; product is "a slow-release insert", which is occupied ground
detection_method: Release fraction vs RH curve; look for a step
mitigation: Binder selection for sharp hydration response; threshold-forming layer
kill_criterion: Release vs RH is smooth and shallow across binders, i.e. no engineerable threshold exists

cause: Sensitivity to package volume/fruit mass/temperature
consequence: Cannot specify a dose; the differentiator collapses
detection_method: Replicate headspace runs across a package-volume and fruit-mass matrix; report CV
mitigation: Dose by area; specify inserts per unit volume; compensate via coat weight
kill_criterion: Replicate CV remains high after formulation optimisation, so no dose specification can be written

cause: Release kinetics strongly temperature dependent
consequence: Cold-chain excursion causes early dumping or under-dosing
detection_method: Arrhenius series across the temperature matrix
mitigation: Select binder with low activation energy for water transport; specify handling limits
kill_criterion: Release differs so strongly between refrigerated and ambient that no single dose is safe

cause: Coating process variation
consequence: Dose varies insert to insert
detection_method: Gravimetric coat weight per unit area; cross-sectional microscopy
mitigation: Meyer-rod then slot-die; SPC on coat weight
kill_criterion: Coat weight cannot be held within the tolerance the dose specification requires

cause: Weak binder-to-paper bond
consequence: Active sheds into the package; contamination and dose loss
detection_method: Tape/rub test; visual dust check
mitigation: Binder with paper affinity; adjust pigment/binder ratio
kill_criterion: Persistent shedding at any workable binder level

failure_mode: Off-odour or flavour taint (if EO added)
cause: Essential oil vapour at antimicrobial dose
consequence: Rejected by buyers; commercially fatal
detection_method: Triangle test sensory panel with untrained and trained panellists
mitigation: Defer EO to v2; separate outer layer; dose below sensory threshold
kill_criterion: Sensory panel detects taint at the minimum effective antimicrobial dose

cause: Oil plasticises the layer and raises water-vapour permeability
consequence: Antimicrobial function degrades the primary function
detection_method: Compare release curves with and without EO
mitigation: Spatial separation (bilayer); omit EO in v1
kill_criterion: EO cannot be included without materially degrading 1-MCP control

cause: EO displaces 1-MCP from CD cavities
consequence: Loss of payload
detection_method: Assay 1-MCP retention in complex with and without EO contact
mitigation: Use alpha-CD (small cavity); keep EO in a separate layer and separate CD
kill_criterion: Measurable displacement that separation cannot prevent

cause: New delivery format requires registration action; crop-specific labels
consequence: No route to market regardless of technical success
detection_method: Early pre-submission consultation with EPA and a regulatory consultant
mitigation: Engage specialists in Phase 1; design to an existing registered format where possible
kill_criterion: Regulatory counsel advises a new registration with cost/time beyond project resources

cause: Cellresin/Kimberly-Clark coated-substrate and laminate claims; Vidre+ delayed-release claims
consequence: Cannot commercialise; possible infringement exposure
detection_method: Claim-by-claim review by patent counsel; updated FTO search
mitigation: Avoid second-substrate laminate; differentiate on specification not format
kill_criterion: Counsel finds no practicable design-around of a blocking claim

cause: Complex-grade cyclodextrin and low volume
consequence: No commercial case even if it works
detection_method: Cost model with sensitivity to volume
mitigation: Minimise materials; use commodity binder and paper; design for existing lines
kill_criterion: Modelled cost per insert exceeds incumbent consumables at realistic volume with no path down

cause: Vapour concentration below MIC in real package
consequence: Antimicrobial claim unsupportable
detection_method: In-package challenge testing against target organism
mitigation: Raise dose (bounded by sensory); reconsider EO choice
kill_criterion: No dose satisfies both MIC and sensory acceptability

failure_mode: Scale-up fails from lab to roll-to-roll
cause: Lab casting has no industrial analogue; line speed and drying differ
consequence: Cannot manufacture at cost
detection_method: Pilot trial on Meyer-rod then slot-die; compare release curves lab vs pilot
mitigation: Choose a lab method with an industrial analogue from the start
kill_criterion: Pilot-coated material cannot reproduce lab release behaviour

cause: Direct or indirect contact transfer
consequence: Food-safety and compliance failure
detection_method: Migration testing to the relevant food-contact protocol
mitigation: Non-contact insert; barrier layer; formal migration study
kill_criterion: Migration exceeds permitted limits and cannot be engineered out

failure_mode: Analytical method not fit for purpose
cause: No bottled 1-MCP standard; sampling depletes headspace
consequence: Every release number is wrong; conclusions unsafe
detection_method: Calibration with mass balance; sacrificial-vial sampling; blanks and leak tests
mitigation: Sacrificial vials; document LOD/LOQ; GC-MS confirmation of peak identity
kill_criterion: Calibration cannot be established with acceptable accuracy

failure_mode: Binder or paper emits interfering volatiles
cause: Coating and substrate off-gassing
consequence: False positives in release measurement
detection_method: Blank inserts (no complex) on every GC run
mitigation: Screen substrates and binders for clean chromatograms early
kill_criterion: No clean substrate/binder combination available
